text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wah, what a lovely melody~.
I wonder where it's playing from?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wait... E-Earth-san playing live!?
Amazing, I had no idea she was holding a concert like this!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Apparently, a crowd started gathering
while they were practicing their instruments.
Well, I guess I'm one of them, though...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
It's seriously such a mesmerizing performance~.
Man, I'd listen to it anywhere, anytime!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I called out to Sounds of Earth,
who had just finished her practice performance.
choice_data_list: The crowd of spectators has grown quite a bit.
The crowd of spectators has grown quite a bit, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but... lamentabile.
Trainer, I have come to a realization.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The Pratica—no, the courtyard concert was well received.
However, I believe we must not stop here.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"We need to spread these bright 'sounds' all across the academy!
—Let's kick off our academy live tour!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Earth is doing live accompaniment
for today's dance lesson, huh.

text_block_list.name: Dance Lesson Teacher
text_block_list.text: What a magnificent performance... I'm totally captivated! Today, let's make it an expression lesson dancing along to her melody!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da-da-daaah! Ta-da-daaaah!
Omachi is spinning even more than usual today!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoaaaa! Machitan's spinning round and round!
Then Turbo will too! Turbo's gonna spin too~!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Moving to the music, in your own way...
In other words, letting your individuality shine!
This looks like great self-producing practice!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Um... what should I eat for lunch?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Lunch today comes with elegant live music?
It's such an oriental melody!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah. ...It kinda brings back memories.
Like of high-end Chinese restaurants and such.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Eh, I was thinking the exact same thing!
Chinese food for lunch today it is!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Well then... I'll have the mapo tofu.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Fantastico!
It was overflowing with joyful "sounds"!
choice_data_list: Ah, it was a wonderful live tour!
Yeah, it was a wonderful live tour!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì! A melodia spreading through the academy!
A melodia that is always by our side!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"If there is another chance in the future
to help people connect with 'sound'――"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, there you are! Earth-san!
The live tour's been a huge hit, hasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: So, um, I have a favor to ask...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: I'd like to ask you to play the race fanfare!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: M-Mamma mia!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
There's a gentle breeze blowing...
Yet somehow, it carries a sense of heat.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
To everyone taking on this mock race,
allow me to present a single, beautiful flower full of courage.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ――Well then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(—Dun-dun-dun-dun, duuun!!
Dun-dun-dun-dun, duuun!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ta-daaa!!)

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
――~~!! ...Power is surging through me!
――This is a serious race, there's no way I'm losing!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now, Angelo!
Enchant us with a full-throttle session!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Sounds of Earth delivered
his bright "sound" to every last corner
of the academy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Dun-dun-dun-daaa! 
Dun-dun-dun-daaa!)

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
—All riiiight!!
—I'm not gonna lose!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Angelo!
Enchant us with everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sounds of Earth met the students' expectations, delivering a splendid fanfare.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ta-da-da, daaah...)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: !? The string's tuning is...

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
—Oh?
—Does that somehow take the wind out of your sails?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth got a little too pumped up,
and ended up blowing it right at the crucial moment...
